Kanye West (Ye) in Phoenix: State Farm Stadium, Nov 21

Scottsdale Sprinters’ short answer: Ye, the artist formerly known as Kanye West, plays State Farm Stadium in Glendale on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with a 7:00 p.m. start listed and no doors time published. The stadium recommends pre-paying for parking on SeatGeek, its car parks take cards only, and the Black Lot south of the stadium is the drop-off and pickup.

Prices start at $125 an hour for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $500 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

When is Ye (Kanye West) in Phoenix, and where is the show?

Ye, the artist formerly known as Kanye West, is at State Farm Stadium in Glendale on Saturday, November 21, 2026, for a single night billed as Ye Live in Phoenix. The stadium’s event page gives a 7:00 p.m. start and publishes no doors time. The venue is 1 Cardinals Drive, Glendale, AZ 85305: the Cardinals’ home in the West Valley, off Loop 101, a different trip from downtown Phoenix. Book the night rather than one leg. With the vehicle on the clock, the same chauffeur takes you out and brings you back.

Where do you park for Ye at State Farm Stadium?

State Farm Stadium recommends pre-paying for parking on SeatGeek. Arrive without a pre-paid space and any of its car parks will take a credit or debit card, but cash is not accepted. A concert runs its own parking plan, apart from Cardinals game days, so read the event page before you set off. The venue guide on this site has the lot map, the exit routes and a longer parking answer. The other route is a chauffeured drop-off at the Black Lot, which removes both the payment and the wait in the exit queue.

Where is the drop-off and pickup for Ye?

The stadium’s named drop-off and pickup for rideshare, family and friends is the Black Lot, on the south side across Cardinals Way. No limo or charter lane is published, so a chauffeured vehicle follows the traffic plan for the night. After the show every rideshare passenger leaves from that one lot. A booked vehicle avoids the queue by meeting the group at a spot agreed beforehand.

What can you bring into State Farm Stadium for Ye?

The stadium’s rule is one clear bag up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a one-gallon freezer bag, alongside a strong recommendation to carry no bag at all. Guests pass a metal detector and bags are searched at the gate. There is nowhere at the stadium to store or safeguard a prohibited bag: the guest is told to take it back to the car. A group we drop off has no car to go back to, so anything prohibited stays at the hotel. The event page’s prohibited list includes alcoholic drinks, coolers, outside food (a child under two is exempt), umbrellas over 12 inches, selfie sticks and cameras with professional lenses. One sealed 500 mL bottle of plain water is allowed.

Can children go to Ye at State Farm Stadium, and are signs allowed?

Children can attend, but the event page says all guests need a ticket regardless of age. Diaper bags are on the prohibited list, and umbrella-style strollers pass only after inspection. Signs larger than 3 by 2 feet, or carrying a non-sport message, are not allowed, so measure before you paint one.

How should a group plan a Ye night?

Count back from the 7:00 p.m. start. Because the stadium publishes no doors time, aim to reach the Black Lot early enough for the gate search and the walk to your seats. Pay by the hour for the whole evening, with dinner at Westgate as part of it if you like, or split it into a ride out and a ride home. Flying in? A pickup at Sky Harbor or your Valley hotel can lead straight to the stadium in the same vehicle.

Is there a premium or VIP option for Ye at State Farm Stadium?

The stadium sells premium seating for groups of 2 to 150 and says its packages include complimentary parking and expedited entry; the event page links VIP packages. Hosts with premium seats still need a way there and back. The Maybach Jet or the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter handles both legs on one booking.

Which vehicle fits a group going to Ye?

Our pick for a stadium night is the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter: it seats 15 and books at $250 an hour. Hosting? The Maybach Jet Sprinter seats 9, and the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban) suit a smaller VIP party. A crew chooses between the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax) (13 seats), the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) (16) and the Party Bus (28 Pax) (28), at $175 an hour, $175 an hour and $250 an hour respectively. Rates are per vehicle, not per person, and each vehicle has a minimum booking shown on its fleet page. Families take the Executive Black Sprinter, with 14 reclining leather seats at $145 an hour, or the Mini Bus (24 Pax), which seats 24. Frequently asked questions

When is the Kanye West concert in Phoenix in 2026?

One night only: Saturday, November 21, 2026, at State Farm Stadium in Glendale, with a 7:00 p.m. start on the stadium’s event page.

Is Ye the same as Kanye West?

Yes. Ye is the artist formerly known as Kanye West, as KTAR and the ticket listings put it. The stadium’s own page bills the show as Ye Live in Phoenix.

Where is the Ye concert in Phoenix?

In Glendale, not in Phoenix proper: State Farm Stadium, 1 Cardinals Drive, in the Westgate area west of downtown, off Loop 101.

How do you park for Ye at State Farm Stadium?

Pre-pay on SeatGeek, as the stadium recommends, or pay at any stadium car park with a credit or debit card. Cash is not accepted.

To the Black Lot, on the south side of the stadium across Cardinals Way, which the stadium names as its drop-off and pickup for rideshare, family and friends.

What bag can you carry into Ye at State Farm Stadium?

One clear bag no larger than 12 by 6 by 12 inches, or a one-gallon freezer bag. The stadium recommends no bag at all and has nowhere to keep one.

Does a child need a ticket for Ye?

Yes. According to the stadium’s event page, every guest needs a ticket, whatever the age.

Can a limo or party bus drop us off at Ye?

Yes, at the point stadium and traffic staff direct on the night. No limo or charter lane is published, so your chauffeur confirms the spot and agrees a pickup point with you for the trip home.

Where do you buy tickets for Ye in Phoenix?

The stadium’s Ye Live in Phoenix event page is the official listing: presale began on Wednesday, September 9, and tickets went on sale on Thursday, September 10, at 10 a.m. We do not sell tickets and print no ticket price.
